runtimeInspection.limitation: Literal require/import inventory only; computed imports and behavioral authority require source review

qualificationLimits: Synthetic controlled services and keys; no live Tor/service/deployment qualification.
Withdrawal fixtures use an authenticated archive plus main-only pass-through instrumentation for synthetic ASP labels.
A size/digest pin authenticates bytes; it is not a protocol audit, reproducible build, distribution permission or containment of main-process authority.
Archival explicitly stops revalidation of accepted unverified RPC evidence. Exact reuse guards remain.
Each journal retains at most 64 live records and 1024 permanent tombstones, with no eviction. Capacity can ultimately refuse emergency exit.
Any journal write migrates to version 2; older branch builds refuse it.
Archival has one shared maximum 120-second deadline for two RPC passes and review; actual Tor latency remains unqualified.
Portable backup, rollback resistance, product UX, broad platform containment and production activation remain open.
